heading.label: Heading
heading.info: Leave empty to use the heading set in Sillages.

api_base.label: Sillages API
api_base.info: Only change this if Sillages support asks you to.

layout_width.label: Width
layout_width.info: Full width breaks out of the section it sits in, so the gallery reads as its own part of the page.

replace_catalog.label: Replace the theme grid on collection pages
replace_catalog.info: On a collection page the gallery shows the same products your theme's grid does. Leave this on and the gallery takes its place. Turn it off and both are shown.
